Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 
PLAYGROUND  EQUIPMENT  FOR  PARKS 

PART  IV  JUNGLE  GYMS  (OR  CASTLE  CLIMBERS) 


1,  Scope  —  Specifies  requirements  for  jungle  gyms  or  castle  climbers  erected  in  parks  as  playground 

equipment. 

2»  Materials  — As  in  2  of  IS  :  6869  (  Part  I  )-1973  '  Specification  for  playground  equipment  for  parks: 
Part  I  General  requirements'. 

3.  Dimensions 

3.1  Height  —  Tlie  higliest  point  shall  be  not  more  than  32  m  above  ground  level. 


3.2  Spacing  of  Vertical  Tubes  —  Vertical  tubes 
than  680  mm  centres. 


shall   be  spaced  not  less  than  380  mm  and  not  more 


3.Z  Spacing  of  Horizontai  Tubes — Adjacent  horizontal  tubes  shall  be  spaced  at  300  mm  for  jungle 
gyms  to  be  used  by  children  In  the  age  group  of  6  to  8  years  and  at  600  mm  for  jungle  gyms  to  be  used 
by  children  tn  the  age  group  of  9  to  12  years,  vertical  and  horizontal  centres  except  where  passage 
ways  are  provided.    There  shall  be  not  more  than  two  passage  ways  which  may  intersect  each  other. 

Z A  Size  of  Vertical  Tubes  —  The  corner  vertical  tubes  shall  be  not  less  than  42*4  mm  dia,  2'6  mm 
thick.    The  intermediate  vertical  tube  shall  be  not  less  than  26"9  mm  dia  and  3*2  mm  thick. 

3.5  Size  of  Horizontal  Tubes — The  horizontal  tubes  shall  be  not  less  than  26*9  mm  diameter* 
2'3  mm  thick.  Where  the  height  of  the  equipment  above  ground  level  does  not  exceed  2'1  m  and  the 
unsupported  space  does  not  exceed  400  mm,  tubes  not  less  than  2  V3  mm  dia  and  2*0  mm  thick 
^hall  be  permitted. 

3.6  Sole  Plates  —  Shall  be  not  less  than  1 50  mm  square  and  6'30  mm  thick. 

2J  Sinkings  —  The  site  area  of  the  jungle  gyms  shall  be  the  area  on  plan  of  the  jungle  gym  with  an 
additional  surrounding  space  100  mm  wide.  The  whole  site  area  shall  be  excavated  to  a  depth  of 
100  mm  plus  12  mm  additional  depth  for  each  300  mm  height  of  the  equipment.  The  lowest 
50  mm  of  the  excavation  shall  be  filled  in  with  concrete.  The  base  of  the  vertical  tubes  shall  be  placed 
on  the  concrete  and  a  further  50  mm  of  concrete  shall  be  laid  over  the  site  area.  The  remainder 
of  the  excavation  shall  be  filled  with  sand  or  soil  or  tar  maca,dam  or  with  combinations  of  ihese 
materials. 

4.  Construction —  The  jungle  gyms  shall  be  constructed  in  accordance  with  4  of  IS :  6869 
(  Part  I). 1973. 

5.  Workmanship  and   Finish  — Provisions  of  3.1,  3.2,  3.3  and  3.5  of   IS  :  6869    (Part  l)-1973 

shall  apply.  ^ 

6.  Marking—  Provisions  of  6  of  IS  :  6869  (  Part  I  )-1973  shall  apply. 

6.1  ISI  Certification  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution,  New  Delhi.* 

7.  Packing  —  Provisions  of  7  of  IS  :  6869  (  Part  I  )-1 973  shall  apply. 


Adopted  20  February  1973
